_comment: Open-source tools, libraries and open datasets this repository adopted after Price approved them in his weekly tool picks issue (docs/SCOUT_BUILDS.md).
The shared scouts in pricephillips/data-centers find and screen candidates and keep every verdict in that repository's registry; this file records only what was built here, by renewables-integrator.

tools[]: id (the scouts' registry id), name, kind (dataset, python, npm, cli, action, service), license, version (the pin), source_url, target (files changed), approved (the picks issue number, or 'Price, in a session, YYYY-MM-DD'), built_on (YYYY-MM-DD), proof (the workflow that proved it live).
tests/test_adopted_tools.py checks the shape. Name no client here: this repository is public.
